description: Enable Xiaohe Shuangpin in Windows Microsoft Pinyin for the current user.
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'This package configures HKCU. Install without --global.' }
notes: Xiaohe Shuangpin has been enabled in Microsoft Pinyin for the current user.
If the IME has not refreshed, switch input methods or sign out and back in.
Run xiaohe-shuangpin -Mode Restore to restore the original three registry values.
Uninstall keeps IME settings and the backup. Restore first if you want to revert.
